turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; start there.
I'll stand until I hear something worth sitting for. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
You were so gracious on the phone. I'd been dreading this and you made it easy.
Don't manage me, Hale. That phone call came after the zero was already in the gradebook. Who decided, and on what basis?
So can we agree the zero stands and move on? You strike me as someone who knows which battles are worth picking.
No. The zero comes off, and you still haven't told me what it's based on. If the answer is nothing, I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done.
